Eli (People Ops): Heads-up: we're rolling handbook v2.1 on Friday. It includes the parental leave clarifications and a new remote-work equipment allowance. Need to coordinate compliance training windows, affected managers, and update slack ack tracking.
Priya (HR): Thanks. Do we have a blackout period for hiring this week? Nora, any constraints from hiring ops? :thinking:
Nora (Hiring Ops): We have two onsite interviews Fri afternoon. Avoid major policy all-hands during 13:00-16:00 PT. Also please don't change offer templates this deploy window.
Eli (People Ops): Noted. Plan: publish handbook draft on Wed, open a 48h comment window, enforce final publish Friday 09:00 PT. Compliance training reminder (mandatory) will go out Mon and a final ack by 4/15.
Rob: Can we auto-track acks? Last time manual tracking had gaps.
Eli (People Ops): Yeah we're updating the ack sheet and adding a tiny script to pull Slack reactions and calendar RSVPs. Onboarding Bot will bump missed acks automatically after the first reminder.
Onboarding Bot: Automated message: New handbook v2.1 will be published Fri 09:00 PT. Mandatory acknowledgment required by 4/15. Training sessions scheduled next Tue/Thu mornings. Recording available in Playbook > Handbook > Recordings.
Priya (HR): I'm adding a short FAQ for managers about parental leave timelines and equipment allowance approval flow. Will also publish a one-page checklist managers must confirm.
Nora (Hiring Ops): Please include a note for recruiters: don't promise equipment allowances that exceed the new policy. We'll update offer checklist after publish.
Eli (People Ops): Action items: 1) Priya to publish manager FAQ by Thu EOD, 2) Nora to circulate recruiter note, 3) Rob to review ack script and run a dry-run on Wed, 4) Onboarding Bot to schedule reminders Mon/Tue. I'll attach the ack spreadsheet once Rob signs off.
Rob: I'll run the dry-run Wed 10:00 and report any mismatches. If >5% missing acks after reminders, escalate to people ops leads.
Priya (HR): Also adding translation note for EU/FR locales; will tag localized owners. If anyone has region-specific legal flags ping me directly.
Eli (People Ops): Great. I'll post the publish notice in #general and #people-ops when live. Quick question: do we want to gate handbook ack for contractors?
Nora (Hiring Ops): Contractors get a simplified ack. Add them to a separate sheet and tag managers for compliance exceptions.
Eli (People Ops): Sounds good. I'll include contractor toggle in the ack script. Thanks all — aiming for frictionless rollout. :shipit:
